channels.name: Vanessa Joy
channels.description: 20+ year professional wedding photographer, Canon Explorer of Light (an honor given to only 5 photographers in the US), 145,000+ subscribers. Channel exists explicitly for 'photography AND business education' — pricing, sales sessions, post-wedding workflow, client experience — not just technique.
channels.verificationMethod: Extremely well corroborated across 10+ independent sources (her own channel About section, Voyage Austin interview, Animoto case study on her video-driven $20K sales increase, multiple video titles specifically about business topics). One of the strongest finds this session.

channels.name: The Futur
channels.description: Chris Do's channel, already verified for Graphic Design (skill_11) — cross-tagged here because FlashFilm Academy's roundup of business-of-photography channels specifically names The Futur as valuable for photographers too, not just designers, since it teaches business fundamentals (pricing, positioning, sales) that apply across creative fields.
channels.verificationMethod: Same channel already verified for skill_11; cross-tagged based on an independent source (FlashFilm Academy) explicitly recommending it for photographers/videographers specifically.

notes: Photography YouTube is dominated by gear reviews and technique tutorials (Peter McKinnon, Thomas Heaton, Tony & Chelsea Northrup) — real, popular, valuable for the craft, but not counted here since none focus on running the business. Blog and free-book search not yet done this round.
